context_notes: This session was an audit-fix run that grew into test-infrastructure work by owner ruling. The recurring shape across every finding: a guard that models STRUCTURE and not TRUTH — a citation that parses but points nowhere, a frontmatter key that is present but false, a discrimination rule written in a failure message but not in the condition. Three times a subagent refused an instruction of mine and was right; none of the three errors reached a file. Three times the thing that caught an error was a COUNT that moved the wrong way, not a red test.
